subject: Post-call: model mix & token volumes — pricing next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up & next steps from today's discovery call — model mix + volumes

Hi Alex — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment: 

Summary of needs (from the call)
- Primary use case: in-product AI assistant for enterprise support (chat + contextual rerank)
- Secondary: embeddings for semantic search across KB and docs
- Latency SLO: p95 < 400ms for chat; lower priority for batch embedding jobs
- Data residency: US; will likely run on Redwood Dedicated initially

Open items we agreed to confirm:
1) Expected monthly token volumes by model type (chat vs. rerank vs. embeddings)
2) Target budget range / target $ per 1M tokens (to align on pricing tiers)
3) Any procurement constraints or required paperwork from your side

For item (1) — can you confirm approximate monthly volumes (ballpark ranges are fine) for: 
- Chat (assistant generation): e.g., 10M tokens/month
- Rerank (short scoring requests): e.g., 1M tokens/month
- Embeddings (batch/ingest + runtime): e.g., 500k tokens/month

For item (2) — to give you a concrete pricing example I attached our current pricing sheet with tiered unit economics and a worked example for a 1M token bucket. If you have a target $/1M tokens that you'd like us to hit for a committed plan, share that and we can model options (Dedicated reservation vs hosted discounts).

Next steps: 
- Alex: send ballpark volumes + any procurement timing (ETA for legal/contact) — by EOD Fri if possible
- Marissa / Redwood: share a tailored pricing example and draft MAP (attached)

Attachments: redwood_pricing_sheet_v2.pdf, brightlayer_map_draft.xlsx

Thanks —
Marissa

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@brightlayer.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@brightlayer.com
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up & next steps from today's discovery call — model mix + volumes

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming ballparks below (these are expected steady-state in 3–4 months after rollout):

- Chat (generation): 18M tokens/month (avg; peak bursts up to ~35M)
- Rerank (short scoring calls): 2.2M tokens/month
- Embeddings (ingest + runtime): 1.1M tokens/month (bulk ingest monthly)

Budget guidance: we are targeting an initial vendor cost of roughly $2,000–$4,000/month while we pilot. If we look at committed growth (next 12 months), we can stretch to a contour where unit economics target ~ $250–$500 / 1M tokens for certain high-throughput models, but we would expect better pricing for large committed Dedicated reservations.

Procurement: procurement@brightlayer.com will need a SOW + MSA. They prefer DocuSign and typically take 2–3 weeks for review. No special security questionnaire yet — we'll flag if they need SOC2 artifacts.

Happy to hop on a short call if you want to talk commitment tiers — otherwise send over the worked pricing and a recommended plan and we can route internally.

—Alex

BrightLayer

Subject: Re: Follow-up & next steps from today's discovery call — model mix + volumes (pricing worked example)

Thanks Alex — this is super helpful. Based on the volumes you provided, I put together a short worked example showing unit economics across model types and two procurement scenarios (hosted with committed usage discount vs Dedicated reserved capacity). See summary below and the attached pricing sheet for line-item math.

Summary (monthly steady-state)
- Chat: 18M tokens/month — modeled on a mix of chat-opt (60%) and chat-lowcost (40%) variants
- Rerank: 2.2M tokens/month — assumed as short calls (low token per call) using rerank model
- Embeddings: 1.1M tokens/month — one bulk ingest per month + realtime lookups

Worked example: target $/1M tokens and total monthly cost
- Target unit goal you mentioned: $250–$500 / 1M tokens (we modeled both)

Option A — Hosted (committed 12mo discount)
- Effective blended unit price (modeled): $420 / 1M tokens => Estimated monthly cost: $9,828

Option B — Dedicated (4x reserved GPUs)
- Effective blended unit price (modeled): $180 / 1M tokens => Estimated monthly cost: $4,212

Notes and assumptions
- Blended unit price estimates assume the split above (chat 60/40) and typical token-per-request averages: chat 125 tokens/response, rerank 12 tokens/score, embeddings 768-d vector per text chunk (pricing per embed modeled as token-equivalent).
- Dedicated estimate includes amortized infra + support SLA; Hosted assumes committed usage discount but higher marginal costs for burst traffic.
- We can tighten estimates if you share detailed tokenization samples or a week of request logs (anonymized).

Recommended next steps
1) Please confirm whether your procurement team prefers 'price-first' (aim at Hosted with a commit) vs 'performance-first' (Dedicated reservation).
2) If price-first, confirm the target $/1M token (pick a number in $/1M) so I can produce an illustrative 12-mo committed quote.
3) If performance-first, confirm expected peak concurrent requests and we will size Dedicated nodes and provide an SLA-backed offer.

I'll follow up with a concise single-page quote and MAP for procurement once you confirm direction.

Thanks —
Marissa
[Attachment: redwood_pricing_sheet_v2.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@brightlayer.com>

Subject: Re: Follow-up & next steps from today's discovery call — model mix + volumes

Marissa — that breakdown is exactly what we needed, thank you. Quick answers: 

- Procurement preference: price-first for the pilot (we'll likely go Hosted with a 6–12 month commit if the pilot looks good).
- Target unit price: aim for $300 / 1M tokens for the pilot phase; we can revisit for Dedicated when we scale.
- Procurement: I'll ask procurement to expect a short SOW + the MAP. Procurement (procurement@brightlayer.com) will pull DocuSign details this afternoon.

Next step: Can you send the 6- and 12-month committed-worked quotes (with the $300 / 1M target for the pilot) and a draft SOW? If possible, include an option for automatic uplift to Dedicated pricing at a defined threshold.

I'll loop legal on Monday if we move forward.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.
Alex
